general.name: Docker - Container Health and Resource Usage [Lin]
general.description: Alerts when a container is unhealthy, restart-looping, OOM-killed, exited non-zero, or over CPU/memory thresholds, or Docker does not answer. Read-only; never starts a stopped Docker. https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components

variables.name: usrCpuThreshold
variables.description: Percent of the container's own CPU allowance (not of one core). 1-100.

variables.name: usrMemThreshold
variables.description: Percent of the container's memory limit (of host RAM when it has none). 1-100.

variables.name: usrConsecutive
variables.description: Runs in a row a container must breach CPU or memory before it alerts. 1-10.

variables.name: usrCheckHealth
variables.description: An unhealthy healthcheck: Alert, Warn (named in the status only) or Ignore.

variables.name: usrRestartThreshold
variables.description: Restarts since the previous run that alert. 1 or more.

variables.name: usrExitedWindowMin
variables.description: Minutes a non-zero exit is reported for. 0 turns the exited-container check off.

variables.name: usrStoppedExitAction
variables.description: A container that exited 143 or 137 without being OOM-killed (usually docker stop): Warn (named in the status only) or Alert. OOM kills always alert.

variables.name: usrExclude
variables.description: Extended regex matched against container names (running and exited); matches are skipped. e.g. ^(ci-|tmp-)

variables.name: usrIncludeLogs
variables.description: Yes adds the last 20 log lines of up to 3 alerting containers to the diagnostic, and says so in the status. Logs can carry secrets.
